data.name: OverrideQueryString
data.value: select GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType as DocumentTypeName from GL_TransactionHeader inner join Set_DocumentType on Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID and Set_DocumentType.[Status] = 1 WHERE GL_TransactionHeader.[Status] = 1 AND (GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID OR @CompanyID is null) {0}

data.name: Query_BusinessPartnerGL_Report
data.value:
--select 'Opening' AS DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name, -1 AS SourceID, SUM(TABopening.Amount) as Amount, -- '' AS InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as DetailNarration, '' AS InvoiceNumbers, '' AS InvoiceDocumentNo, '' AS DocumentNo, @FromDate AS DocumentDate, -- 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 AS ForAlhajAmount
select @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name as CustomerName,'' as DocumentNo, (case when Sum(TABopening.Amount)>0 then Abs(Sum(TABopening.Amount)) else 0 end)as debit,
(case when Sum(TABopening.Amount)<0 then Abs(Sum(TABopening.Amount)) else 0 end) as credit, '' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments,'' as CodeCombinationID,'' as CodeDescription
-- select '01-01-17' AS DocumentDate, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,'100-HO-Corporate Office' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.Name,0 as DocumentNo,0 as debit,SUM(TABopening.Amount) as credit, --null as InstrumentNo,'BEING RECEIVED LOAN FROM FOSSIL ENERGY (PVT) LTD TO MEET PAYMENT OF LC MARGIN OF AD SCREENS' as Comments,'2-01-04-01-01-0005' as CodeCombinationID,'Loan from Fossil' as CodeDescription
from ( SELECT FINTAB.DocumentType, Fintab.CreateDate, FINTAB.CustomerID, FINTAB.Name, FinTab.SourceID, SUM(FINTAB.Amount) as Amount, FINTAB.InstrumentNo, FINTAB.Comments, FINTAB.InvoiceNumbers, FINTAB.InvoiceDocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentNo, FINTAB.DocumentDate, FINTAB.FreightAmount, FINTAB.ForAlhajAmount FROM ( Select 'Opening' as DocumentType, @FromDate AS CreateDate, openingTAB.CustomerID, openingTAB.Name, -1 AS SourceID, sum(openingTAB.Amount) as Amount, '' as InstrumentNo, '' as Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, '' as DocumentNo, @FromDate as DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount From ( ---------- OPENING BALANCE VENDOR INVOICE ---------- SELECT 0 as Amount, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS Name, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID as SourceID FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail on AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.BusinessPartnerTypeID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
GROUP BY AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.TransactionType, AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptCustomerID ) OpeningTAB GROUP BY OpeningTAB.CustomerID ,OpeningTAB.Name
UNION ALL
select distinct TABInvoice.DocumentType, TABInvoice.CreateDate, TABInvoice.CustomerID, TABInvoice.BusinessPartnerName, TABInvoice.SourceID, TABInvoice.Amount, TABInvoice.InstrumentNo, TABInvoice.Comments, TABInvoice.InvoiceNumbers, TABInvoice.InvoiceDocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentNo, TABInvoice.DocumentDate, TABInvoice.FreightAmount, TABInvoice.ForAlhajAmount from (
SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.companyID, Set_DocumentType.TransactionType, case when AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode is null then ( select top 1 CUS.TypeCode from AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.BusinessPartnerID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode end as TypeCode, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerID from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as CustomerID, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) else ( select CUS.CustomerName from AR_SET_Customer CUS where AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID = CUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = CUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = CUS.PeriodID ) end as BusinessPartnerName, AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceSupplierID as SourceID, case when AR_InvoiceHeader.vendorID is null then (Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount else AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) else ( Case when AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Debit Note' then AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid else AR_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 end ) end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.Description AS Comments, AR_InvoiceHeader.VendorReferenceNumber as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType AND AR_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail on AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail on AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID and AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_Customer ASCUS ON AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.SupplierID = ASCUS.CustomerID --AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.CompanyID = ASCUS.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceSupplierDetail.PeriodID = ASCUS.PeriodID AND ASCUS.Status = 1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_InvoiceHeader.vENDORid AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
WHERE AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate
--and SET_DocumentType.documenttype not like '%Opening%' ) TABInvoice where TABInvoice.companyID = @companyId
-- AND TABInvoice.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {3} UNION ALL ---------- Payment ---------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType when 'Debit' then AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount else AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount * -1 end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail on AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
-- AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {4}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType, AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL
-- PAYMENT -- SINGLE BUSINESS PARTNER CASE SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID as SourceID, (Case when AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType is not null then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount * -1 else AP_PaymentHeader.Amount end) as Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo AS InstrumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.Comments + (Case When AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT distinct AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 0, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumbers, ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT ', ' + AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentDetail WHERE payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentDetail.PaymentHeaderID ORDER BY AP_PaymentDetail.InvoiceDocumentNo FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'varchar(max)'), 1, 2, '') AS InvoiceDocumentNo FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment1 where payment1.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment1.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment1.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ), '') as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount , IsNull(AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, 0) * -1 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode
left join AP_Payment_AccountsDetail on AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.IsBP <> 0 and AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit'
WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate
-- AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {4}
GROUP BY AP_PaymentHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, AP_PaymentHeader.CustomerTransactionType, AP_PaymentHeader.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID, AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID, AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID,AP_PaymentHeader.Comments, AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID,AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo ,AP_Payment_AccountsDetail.Amount, AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header----------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, case when SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid * -1 else SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON SAL_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 -- AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {4} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerName = 'Customer' LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID NOT IN (SELECT InvoiceHeaderID FROM Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail)
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, SAL_InvoiceHeader.AmountPaid, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount
UNION ALL -----------Sale Invoice Header Detail Data----------- SELECT SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID as SourceID, (case when Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType ='Credit' or SET_DocumentType.DocumentType = 'Credit Note' then SUM(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount *-1) else SUM(Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount) end )Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, '' AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, 0) AS DocumentNo, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate AS DocumentDate, CASE WHEN GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' THEN ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount * -1, 0) else ISNULL(SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount, 0) end as FreightAmount , 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN SAL_InvoiceHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType inner join Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail on Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID and Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 --AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {4} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode LEFT JOIN GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightCode AND GL_TransactionDetail.SourceHeaderID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = SAL_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID
WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate < @FromDate --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND
GROUP BY SAL_InvoiceHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID, Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.Amount, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber, SAL_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceDate, SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType, SAL_InvoiceHeader.FreightAmount ,Sal_InvoiceCustomerDetail.TransactionType
union all --RECEIPT TRANSACTION SELECT distinct SET_DocumentType.DocumentType, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CreateDate, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID, AR_SET_Customer.CustomerName AS BusinessPartnerName, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID as SourceID, Case when ( select Amount from AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail rad where rad.TransactionType = 'Credit' and rad.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID and rad.ReceiptAccountID = AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptAccountID ) is null then AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 else AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Amount * -1 end as Amount, '0' AS InstrumentNo, IsNull(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Comments, '') + (Case When AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments IS NULL Then '' Else ' ' + AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments End) AS Comments, '' as InvoiceNumbers, '' as InvoiceDocumentNo, ISNULL(AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentNo, 0) AS DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate AS DocumentDate, 0 AS FreightAmount, 0 As ForAlhajAmount FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 AND AR_SET_Customer.IsActive = 1 -- AND AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID between @BusinessPartnerID AND @BusinessPartnerID {4} INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID
INNER JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail on AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptAccountsDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID
WHERE AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate --AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID = @CompanyID AND and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID not in ( select ReceiptHeaderID from AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail inner join AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader RecHDR on RecHDR.ReceiptTransactionID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and RecHDR.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and RecHDR.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID inner join set_documentType on set_documentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and set_documentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and set_documentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID
where AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and AR_ReceiptCustomerDetail.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID and set_documentType.documentType not like 'Carriage Contractor Adjustment' )

), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail On AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID --And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.IsActive = 1 And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayment on HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentHeaderID= AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.EmpPaymentID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID= AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID Inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Employee Bank Payment' and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType ='Debit' --and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( --select GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID from AR_SET_Customer --inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID --Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID --And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --where AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 )

--Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID left JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID --AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID Qasim Testing Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like 'Advance Against PO%' and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

----------- Advance Against PO
Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and PBD.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.documentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader .Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader .StatusCode = 1
inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--Left Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = (SELECT Max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID = @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID) And DefaultAccountCode is not null)) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit')
left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

---------- Advance Against SO ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID and PBD.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID and PBD.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = ( SELECT max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' AND CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID And DefaultAccountCode is not null ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} {6} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

select @FromDate AS DocumentDate, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,TABopening.InvoiceNumber
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, FinTab.InvoiceNumber FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Invice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalID is null and GL_TransactionHeader.ReversalDate is null and isnull(GL_TransactionHeader.IsReversed,0) = 0 AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate < @FromDate and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As OpeningTAB Group By OpeningTAB.DocumentDate, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID , OpeningTAB.CodeDescription, OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber

,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription,'' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentSupplierID, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT Distinct ',' + AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceDetail ON AR_InvoiceDetail.InvoiceHeaderID = AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID --ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join AP_PaymentSupplierDetail On AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierAccountCode = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID And AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.TransactionType = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType AND AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.Status=1
Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.IsActive = 1 And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.SupplierID And AR_Set_Customer.IsActive = 1 And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1 inner Join HRMS_EmployeePayment on HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentHeaderID= AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.EmpPaymentID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.CompanyID= AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.CompanyID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentSupplierDetail.PeriodID AND HRMS_EmployeePayment.Status = 1
Inner Join HRMS_Set_Employee on HRMS_Set_Employee.PersonID=HRMS_EmployeePayment.PaymentPersonID
Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = HRMS_Set_Employee.CostCenterID Inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Employee Bank Payment' and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then AP_PaymentHeader.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription , STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,case when AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID is null then (ISNULL( ( SELECT STUFF( ( SELECT Distinct ',' + AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FROM AP_PaymentHeader childPayment LEFT JOIN AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail ON AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PaymentHeaderID = childPayment.PaymentID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.CompanyID = childPayment.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.PeriodID = childPayment.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_InvoiceHeader ON AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceID = AP_PaymentInvoicesDetail.InvoiceHeaderID AND AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceDetail.CompanyID = AR_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID AND AR_InvoiceDetail.PeriodID = AR_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID where childPayment.PaymentID = payment.PaymentID and childPayment.CompanyID = payment.CompanyID and childPayment.PeriodID = payment.PeriodID --ORDER BY AR_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InvoiceNumbers FROM AP_PaymentHeader payment where payment.PaymentID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID and payment.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and payment.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
), '')) else (Select DocumentNumber from AP_PurchaseOrderHeader where AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.POHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.POHeaderID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and AP_PurchaseOrderHeader.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID ) end as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 --and GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID in ( --select GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID from AR_SET_Customer --inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID --Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID --And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 --where AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 )
Inner Join AP_PaymentHeader On AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentNo = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And AP_PaymentHeader.Status = 1 And AP_PaymentHeader.StatusCode = 1 and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID
--Inner Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join SET_DocumentType on SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID and SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID INNER JOIN SET_Bucket ON AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = SET_Bucket.CompanyID and SET_Bucket.Status = 1 and SET_Bucket.IsActive = 1 INNER JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID --AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID Qasim Testing Where GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = @CompanyID and GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodID and GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null AND GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate and SET_DocumentType.DocumentType not like 'Advance Against PO%' and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all
----------- Advance Against PO
Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AP_PaymentBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.PaymentHeaderID = AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AP_PaymentHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.documentTypeID AND AP_PaymentHeader .Status = 1 AND AP_PaymentHeader .StatusCode = 1
inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--Left Join AP_PaymentBanksDetail on AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PaymentHeaderID=AP_PaymentHeader.PaymentID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.CompanyID=AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.PeriodID=AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID --AND AP_PaymentBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AP_PaymentHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentTypeID and AP_PaymentHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID AND GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND dbo.GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = (SELECT Max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM dbo.SET_DocumentType WHERE (DocumentType like 'Advance Against PO%') AND (CompanyID = @CompanyID) AND (PeriodID = @PeriodID) And DefaultAccountCode is not null)) AND (dbo.GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit')
left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AP_PaymentHeader.VendorID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID
LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID WHERE AP_PaymentHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AP_PaymentHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AP_PaymentHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And AP_PaymentHeader.ReversalComments is null and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode ,FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all
---------- Advance Against SO ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1
--Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID = ( SELECT max(DefaultAccountCode) FROM SET_DocumentType WHERE DocumentType like 'Advance Against SO%' AND CompanyID = @CompanyID AND PeriodID = @PeriodID And DefaultAccountCode is not null ) AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 left JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID LEFT JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartner ON AR_SET_BusinessPartner.BusinessPartnerID = AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = AR_Set_Customer.CustomerAccountCCID WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber
union all
---------- Receipt against Invoices - Loan Recovery ---------- Select distinct FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, FinTab.InstrumentNo As InstrumentNo, Fintab.Narration As Comments, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode As CodeCombinationID, FinTab.CodeDescription ,FinTab.InvoiceNumber From ( Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PaymentServerOrderNo, ' ' as Narration, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID as SupplierAccountCode, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit, GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription ,STUFF((SELECT ', ' + PBD.InstrumentNo FROM AR_ReceiptBanksDetail PBD WHERE PBD.ReceiptHeaderID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS InstrumentNo ,'' as InvoiceNumber FROM SET_DocumentType INNER JOIN AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader ON SET_DocumentType.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SET_DocumentType.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SET_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.Status = 1 AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.StatusCode = 1 inner JOIN AR_SET_Customer ON AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID = AR_SET_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = AR_SET_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = AR_SET_Customer.PeriodID AND AR_SET_Customer.Status = 1 --Left Join AR_ReceiptBanksDetail on AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.ReceiptHeaderID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReceiptTransactionID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.CompanyID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.PeriodID=AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND AR_ReceiptBanksDetail.Status=1 inner join GL_TransactionHeader on GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.documentNo and GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID and AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID and GL_TransactionHeader.Status=1 INNER JOIN dbo.GL_TransactionDetail ON GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID = GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID AND GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID AND GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID AND GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' AND GL_TransactionDetail.Status=1 Inner JOIN AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes ON AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CustomerID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.TypeCode = AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.BusinessPartnerTypeID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID Left Join Set_CostCenter On Set_CostCenter.CostCenterID = GL_TransactionDetail.CostCenterID inner join GL_codecombinationDetail on GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID WHERE AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.CompanyID = @companyId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.PeriodID = @PeriodId AND AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.DocumentDate BETWEEN @FromDate AND @ToDate And AR_ReceiptTransactionHeader.ReversalComments is null And Set_DocumentType.DocumentType like 'Receipt%Loan Recovery' and (GL_codecombinationDetail.CodeCombinationID = @AccountCode OR @AccountCode is null) And (Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = @DocumentTypeID Or @DocumentTypeID is null) {0} {5} ) As FinTab Group By FinTab.DocumentDate, FinTab.DocumentType, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Fintab.Narration, FinTab.SupplierAccountCode, FinTab.CodeDescription,InstrumentNo,FinTab.InvoiceNumber

data.value:
select DocumentDate,tab.CreateDate,tab.CompanyID,DocumentType,DocumentTypeID ,CostCenterName ,tab.CustomerID ,case when HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode is null then tab.CustomerName else tab.CustomerName + ' (' + HRMS_Set_Employee.EmployeeCode + ')' end as CustomerName ,DocumentNo ,debit ,credit ,InstrumentNo ,Comments ,CodeCombinationID ,CodeDescription ,InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO ,(Select OperatingUnitName from SET_OperatingUnit where OperatingUnitId = tab.CompanyID) as UnitName from ( select @FromDate AS DocumentDate,@FromDate AS CreateDate,CompanyID, 'Opening' AS DocumentType,0 AS DocumentTypeID,'' as CostCenterName, TABopening.CustomerID, TABopening.CustomerName,null as DocumentNo,
Abs(Sum(Debit)) debit,
Sum(credit) as credit,'' as InstrumentNo,'' as Comments, CodeCombinationID CodeCombinationID,CodeDescription ,'' as InvoiceNumber,GRN_NO,PO_NO
from ( SELECT 'Opening' as DocumentType, FinTab.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, FinTab.CostCenterName, FinTab.CustomerID, FinTab.CustomerName, FinTab.DocumentNo, Sum(FinTab.Debit) As Debit, Sum(Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, FinTab.Comments, FinTab.CodeCombinationID ,FinTab.CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber,'' as GRN_NO, '' as PO_NO FROM ( Select distinct OpeningTAB.DocumentDate,CreateDate,CompanyID, OpeningTAB.DocumentType, OpeningTAB.CostCenterName, OpeningTAB.CustomerID, OpeningTAB.CustomerName, OpeningTAB.DocumentNo, Sum(OpeningTAB.Debit) As Debit, Sum(OpeningTAB.Credit) As Credit, '' As InstrumentNo, OpeningTAB.Description As Comments, OpeningTAB.CodeCombinationID ,OpeningTAB.CodeDescription,OpeningTAB.InvoiceNumber From ( --------------- Sale Inovice Select distinct GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CreateDate,GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID, Set_DocumentType.DocumentType, Set_CostCenter.CostCenterName, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID, AR_Set_Customer.CustomerName, GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo, Sal_InvoiceHeader.Description, GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Debit, Case When GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Credit' then GL_TransactionDetail.Amount Else 0 End As Credit ,GL_codecombinationDetail.Description as CodeDescription, '' as InvoiceNumber From GL_TransactionHeader Inner Join GL_TransactionDetail On GL_TransactionDetail.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And GL_TransactionDetail.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionID = GL_TransactionHeader.TransactionID And GL_TransactionDetail.Status = 1 And GL_TransactionDetail.TransactionType = 'Debit' Inner Join Sal_InvoiceHeader On Sal_InvoiceHeader.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceType = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Sal_InvoiceHeader.InvoiceNumber = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentNo And Sal_InvoiceHeader.Status = 1 And Sal_InvoiceHeader.StatusCode = 1 and Sal_InvoiceHeader.FiscalID = GL_TransactionHeader.FiscalID Inner Join Set_DocumentType On Set_DocumentType.CompanyID = GL_TransactionHeader.CompanyID And Set_DocumentType.PeriodID = GL_TransactionHeader.PeriodID And Set_DocumentType.DocumentTypeID = GL_TransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID And Set_DocumentType.Status = 1 Inner Join AR_Set_Customer On AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.PeriodID And AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID = Sal_InvoiceHeader.CustomerID And AR_Set_Customer.Status = 1
Inner Join AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes on AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.BusinessPartnerID=AR_Set_Customer.CustomerID --AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.CompanyID=AR_Set_Customer.CompanyID AND AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.PeriodID=AR_Set_Customer.PeriodID And AR_SET_BusinessPartnerTypes.FK_CodeCombinationID=GL_TransactionDetail.CodeCombinationID
